concepts.name: Service Health Checks
concepts.summary: Node service (server.js + health.js) that probes the ORISO services listed in config.json and renders their status on a single dashboard page (public/index.html).

concepts.name: Cluster Deployment
concepts.summary: Kubernetes wiring for the dashboard itself: ingress definitions, RBAC for in-cluster probing, and a Let's Encrypt cluster issuer.

flows.name: Health Probe Cycle
flows.summary: server.js periodically calls health.js probes against each configured service → aggregates up/down state → the dashboard page displays the result.
